claim_title: Lutein and zeaxanthin supplementation slows the progression of age-related macular degeneration
caption: **Lutein, zeaxanthin and AMD.** The reviewed evidence is suggestive but not conclusive. Supplements slowed damage creeping toward the center of vision, but did not slow the overall growth of the damaged area — the measure the FDA recognises — and the key results **do not survive standard multiple-testing correction**. No improvement in visual acuity was shown, so any benefit remains unconfirmed and needs a trial designed to test this directly.
subtitle: Only one of two outcomes improved, and that result may be due to chance.
